title: ToolCommandMethod
description: A way the harness installs or updates a tool: homebrew; winget; apt or dnf, the vendor's repository added with its signing key; script, the vendor's install script (claude's native installer among them); npm, a global package; scoop, mise or asdf, the package manager's own upgrade of the package the tool was installed as; manual, a binary placed by hand, updated by the vendor's self-update or, for bao, its release archive checked against the published checksums. Only the first five install; the others only update.
